privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introText: Futlance values the privacy and security of its users. This Privacy Policy explains what information may be collected during the use of the site, how this data is used, stored, and protected. By using Futlance, you agree to the practices described in this policy.
privacy.collectDescription: Depending on the features used, Futlance may collect the following information:
privacy.collect1: Browsing information, such as IP address, browser, operating system, and language.
privacy.collect2: Cookies and similar technologies to enhance user experience.
privacy.collect4: Name, email address, and profile picture when the user opts to sign in with a Google account.
privacy.collect5: Phone number provided by the user for the use of the Fan Assistant service (when available).
privacy.collect6: Favorite team chosen for personalized notifications and content.
privacy.collect7: Information related to subscriptions, such as the plan contracted, subscription status, and renewal dates.
privacy.collect8: Other information voluntarily provided by the user during the use of the services.
privacy.useDescription: The collected data may be used to:
privacy.use1: Display personalized content based on user preferences.
privacy.use2: Improve browsing experience and site performance.
privacy.use3: Send notifications related to the Fan Assistant, when contracted by the user.
privacy.use5: Ensure platform security and prevent fraudulent activities.
privacy.use6: Comply with legal and regulatory obligations when necessary.
privacy.shareDescription: Futlance may share collected data with:
privacy.share1: Service providers and partners who assist in operating the platform and providing services.
privacy.share2: Legal authorities when required by law or to protect the rights and safety of users.
privacy.share3: Third parties for marketing and advertising purposes, with user consent.
privacy.securityDescription: Futlance implements security measures to protect user data, including encryption, access controls, and regular security audits. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.rightsDescription: Users have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of their personal data. Users can also withdraw consent at any time. To exercise these rights, please contact us through the provided channels.
privacy.changesDescription: Futlance may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Users will be notified of any significant changes through the platform or other communication channels. We encourage users to review this policy periodically to stay informed about how we are protecting their information.
privacy.contactDescription: If you have any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at: futlanceweb@gmail.com

cookiesPage.title: Cookie Policy
cookiesPage.introText: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help remember preferences, improve navigation, analyze traffic, and provide personalized content.
cookiesPage.necessaryText: These cookies are essential for the proper functioning of the website and cannot be disabled in our systems.
cookiesPage.analyticsText: Used to collect anonymous information about website usage, helping us improve performance and user experience.
cookiesPage.preferencesText: Allow the website to remember choices made by the user, such as language or personalized settings.
cookiesPage.advertisingText: May be used by advertising partners to display relevant ads based on your interests.
cookiesPage.thirdPartyText: Some cookies may be set by third-party services integrated into Futlance, such as analytics tools, advertisements, social media, and authentication services.
cookiesPage.manageText: You can configure your browser to block or delete cookies at any time. However, some website features may not work properly if cookies are disabled.
cookiesPage.changesText: This Cookie Policy may be updated whenever necessary. We recommend reviewing it periodically.
cookiesPage.contactText: If you have any questions about our Cookie Policy, please contact us by email:

terms.title: Terms of Use

terms.usage2: Not attempt to compromise the security or operation of the platform.
terms.usage3: Not use automated tools to collect data without authorization.

terms.subscriptionText: Some services may require a paid subscription. Prices, billing periods, payment methods, renewal conditions, and cancellation policies will be presented before the subscription is completed.

terms.liabilityText: Although we strive to keep all information accurate and up to date, Futlance does not guarantee the complete accuracy or uninterrupted availability of the services and is not responsible for losses resulting from interruptions, technical failures, or third-party information.
terms.terminationText: Futlance may suspend or terminate access to users who violate these Terms or engage in activities that compromise the platform's security or integrity.
